title: The Information Bottleneck Method
relevance: Foundational paper on the information bottleneck method. Provides the mathematical framework for identifying relevant information in signal compression.

title: The Information Bottleneck: Theory and Applications
venue: PhD Thesis, Hebrew University of Jerusalem
relevance: Comprehensive treatment of IB theory and applications including distributional clustering, directly relevant to state-space pruning.

title: Information Bottleneck Signal Processing and Learning to Maximize Relevant Information for Communication Receivers
relevance: Applies IB to communication receiver design, showing how to identify relevant information for decoding—directly analogous to identifying boundary-informative bits.

title: How Does Information Bottleneck Help Deep Learning?
relevance: Rigorous learning theory connecting IB to generalization, applicable to learning optimal probe placement strategies.
